mapper.select: SELECT p.project_code FROM ops_project p JOIN ops_user_project_permission upp ON upp.project_id = p.id WHERE upp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.id

SELECT p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name, p.description, p.icon_text, p.sort_order, p.enabled FROM ops_project p JOIN ops_user_project_permission upp ON upp.project_id = p.id WHERE upp.user_id = #{userId} AND p.enabled = 1 ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ops_user_project_permission (user_id, project_id) SELECT #{userId}, id FROM ops_project WHERE project_code = #{projectCode}
